verses.he: וַיֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَعَادَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ فَأَخَذَ زَوْجَةً ٱسْمُهَا قَطُورَةُ،
verses.en: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.kjv: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name [was] Keturah.
verses.web: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

verses.he: וַתֵּ֣לֶד לֹ֗ו אֶת־זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־שֽׁוּחַ׃
verses.ar: فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ: زِمْرَانَ وَيَقْشَانَ وَمَدَانَ وَمِدْيَانَ وَيِشْبَاقَ وَشُوحًا.
verses.en: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.kjv: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.web: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

verses.he: וְיָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَوَلَدَ يَقْشَانُ: شَبَا وَدَدَانَ. وَكَانَ بَنُو دَدَانَ: أَشُّورِيمَ وَلَطُوشِيمَ وَلَأُمِّيمَ.
verses.en: And Jokshan begot Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو مِدْيَانَ: عَيْفَةُ وَعِفْرُ وَحَنُوكُ وَأَبِيدَاعُ وَأَلْدَعَةُ. جَمِيعُ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو قَطُورَةَ.
verses.en: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these [were] the children of Keturah.
verses.web: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֖ו לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.ar: وَأَعْطَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِسْحَاقَ كُلَّ مَا كَانَ لَهُ.
verses.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.web: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

verses.he: וְלִבְנֵ֤י הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנֹו֙ בְּעֹודֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا بَنُو ٱلسَّرَارِيِّ ٱللَّوَاتِي كَانَتْ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَأَعْطَاهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَطَايَا، وَصَرَفَهُمْ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ ٱبْنِهِ شَرْقًا إِلَى أَرْضِ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ، وَهُوَ بَعْدُ حَيٌّ.
verses.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.kjv: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.web: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَيَّامُ سِنِي حَيَاةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلَّتِي عَاشَهَا: مِئَةٌ وَخَمْسٌ وَسَبْعُونَ سَنَةً.
verses.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

verses.he: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טֹובָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْلَمَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رُوحَهُ وَمَاتَ بِشَيْبَةٍ صَالِحَةٍ، شَيْخًا وَشَبْعَانَ أَيَّامًا، وَٱنْضَمَّ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ.
verses.en: And Abraham expired, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full [of years;] and was gathered to his people.
verses.web: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

verses.he: וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹתֹ֜ו יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל־שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־צֹ֙חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃
verses.ar: وَدَفَنَهُ إِسْحَاقُ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ ٱبْنَاهُ فِي مَغَارَةِ ٱلْمَكْفِيلَةِ فِي حَقْلِ عِفْرُونَ بْنِ صُوحَرَ ٱلْحِثِّيِّ ٱلَّذِي أَمَامَ مَمْرَا،
verses.en: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which [is] before Mamre;
verses.web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

verses.he: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵי־חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְשָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱلْحَقْلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱشْتَرَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مِنْ بَنِي حِثٍّ. هُنَاكَ دُفِنَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَسَارَةُ ٱمْرَأَتُهُ.
verses.en: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth; there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.kjv: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.web: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מֹ֣ות אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנֹ֑ו וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם־בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ ס
verses.ar: وَكَانَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّ ٱللهَ بَارَكَ إِسْحَاقَ ٱبْنَهُ. وَسَكَنَ إِسْحَاقُ عِنْدَ بِئْرِ لَحَيْ رُئِي.
verses.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son; and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.
verses.web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

verses.he: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، ٱلَّذِي وَلَدَتْهُ هَاجَرُ ٱلْمِصْرِيَّةُ جَارِيَةُ سَارَةَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ.
verses.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore unto Abraham.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now these [are] the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמֹות֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתֹולְדֹתָ֑ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ حَسَبَ مَوَالِيدِهِمْ: نَبَايُوتُ بِكْرُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَقِيدَارُ، وَأَدَبْئِيلُ وَمِبْسَامُ
verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.kjv: And these [are] the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.web: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

verses.he: וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.ar: وَمِشْمَاعُ وَدُومَةُ وَمَسَّا
verses.en: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa;
verses.kjv: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

verses.he: חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.ar: وَحَدَارُ وَتَيْمَا وَيَطُورُ وَنَافِيشُ وَقِدْمَةُ.
verses.en: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedem;
verses.kjv: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
verses.web: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ هُمْ بَنُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ بِدِيَارِهِمْ وَحُصُونِهِمْ. ٱثْنَا عَشَرَ رَئِيسًا حَسَبَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ.
verses.en: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Ishmael, and these [are] their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ سِنُو حَيَاةِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ: مِئَةٌ وَسَبْعٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ سَنَةً، وَأَسْلَمَ رُوحَهُ وَمَاتَ وَٱنْضَمَّ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ.
verses.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years; and he expired and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֽ͏ֵחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃ פ
verses.ar: وَسَكَنُوا مِنْ حَوِيلَةَ إِلَى شُورَ ٱلَّتِي أَمَامَ مِصْرَ حِينَمَا تَجِيءُ نَحْوَ أَشُّورَ. أَمَامَ جَمِيعِ إِخْوَتِهِ نَزَلَ.
verses.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Asshur: over against all his brethren he did settle.
verses.kjv: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that [is] before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: [and] he died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.web: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

verses.he: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּולְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: وَلَدَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِسْحَاقَ.
verses.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begot Isaac.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:
verses.web: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתֹּ֣ו אֶת־רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ הֽ͏ָאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲחֹ֛ות לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י לֹ֥ו לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَكَانَ إِسْحَاقُ ٱبْنَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً لَمَّا ٱتَّخَذَ لِنَفْسِهِ زَوْجَةً، رِفْقَةَ بِنْتَ بَتُوئِيلَ ٱلْأَرَامِيِّ، أُخْتَ لَابَانَ ٱلْأَرَامِيِّ مِنْ فَدَّانِ أَرَامَ.
verses.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean, of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.
verses.kjv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

verses.he: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לֽ͏ַיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתֹּ֔ו כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לֹו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَصَلَّى إِسْحَاقُ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ لِأَجْلِ ٱمْرَأَتِهِ لِأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ عَاقِرًا، فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ، فَحَبِلَتْ رِفْقَةُ ٱمْرَأَتُهُ.
verses.en: And Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren; and the LORD let Himself be entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.kjv: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she [was] barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.web: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

verses.he: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَتَزَاحَمَ ٱلْوَلَدَانِ فِي بَطْنِهَا، فَقَالَتْ: «إِنْ كَانَ هَكَذَا فَلِمَاذَا أَنَا؟» فَمَضَتْ لِتَسْأَلَ ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said: 'If it be so, wherefore do I live?' And she went to inquire of the LORD.
verses.kjv: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If [it be] so, why [am] I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.
verses.web: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י *גֹיִים (גֹויִם֙) בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهَا ٱلرَّبُّ: «فِي بَطْنِكِ أُمَّتَانِ، وَمِنْ أَحْشَائِكِ يَفْتَرِقُ شَعْبَانِ: شَعْبٌ يَقْوَى عَلَى شَعْبٍ، وَكَبِيرٌ يُسْتَعْبَدُ لِصَغِيرٍ».
verses.en: And the LORD said unto her: Two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations [are] in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and [the one] people shall be stronger than [the other] people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.web: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

verses.he: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תֹומִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: فَلَمَّا كَمُلَتْ أَيَّامُهَا لِتَلِدَ إِذَا فِي بَطْنِهَا تَوْأَمَانِ.
verses.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, [there were] twins in her womb.
verses.web: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

verses.he: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשֹׁון֙ אַדְמֹונִ֔י כֻּלֹּ֖ו כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמֹ֖ו עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ ٱلْأوَّلُ أَحْمَرَ، كُلُّهُ كَفَرْوَةِ شَعْرٍ، فَدَعَوْا ٱسْمَهُ «عِيسُوَ».
verses.en: And the first came forth ruddy, all over like a hairy mantle; and they called his name Esau.
verses.kjv: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

verses.he: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָדֹ֤ו אֹחֶ֙זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמֹ֖ו יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ خَرَجَ أَخُوهُ وَيَدُهُ قَابِضَةٌ بِعَقِبِ عِيسُو، فَدُعِيَ ٱسْمُهُ «يَعْقُوبَ». وَكَانَ إِسْحَاقُ ٱبْنَ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً لَمَّا وَلَدَتْهُمَا.
verses.en: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob. And Isaac was threescore years old when she bore them.
verses.kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac [was] threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.web: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

verses.he: וֽ͏ַיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃
verses.ar: فَكَبِرَ ٱلْغُلَامَانِ، وَكَانَ عِيسُو إِنْسَانًا يَعْرِفُ ٱلصَّيْدَ، إِنْسَانَ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَيَعْقُوبُ إِنْسَانًا كَامِلًا يَسْكُنُ ٱلْخِيَامَ.
verses.en: And the boys grew; and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
verses.kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob [was] a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.web: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

verses.he: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.ar: فَأَحَبَّ إِسْحَاقُ عِيسُوَ لِأَنَّ فِي فَمِهِ صَيْدًا، وَأَمَّا رِفْقَةُ فَكَانَتْ تُحِبُّ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison; and Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.kjv: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of [his] venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.web: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.he: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃
verses.ar: وَطَبَخَ يَعْقُوبُ طَبِيخًا، فَأَتَى عِيسُو مِنَ ٱلْحَقْلِ وَهُوَ قَدْ أَعْيَا.
verses.en: And Jacob sod pottage; and Esau came in from the field, and he was faint.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he [was] faint:
verses.web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמֹ֖ו אֱדֹֽום׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ عِيسُو لِيَعْقُوبَ: «أَطْعِمْنِي مِنْ هَذَا ٱلْأَحْمَرِ لِأَنِّي قَدْ أَعْيَيْتُ». لِذَلِكَ دُعِيَ ٱسْمُهُ «أَدُومَ».
verses.en: And Esau said to Jacob: 'Let me swallow, I pray thee, some of this red, red pottage; for I am faint.' Therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.kjv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red [pottage;] for I [am] faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיֹּ֛ום אֶת־בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ يَعْقُوبُ: «بِعْنِي ٱلْيَوْمَ بَكُورِيَّتَكَ».
verses.en: And Jacob said: 'Sell me first thy birthright.'
verses.kjv: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.web: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הֹולֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ عِيسُو: «هَا أَنَا مَاضٍ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ، فَلِمَاذَا لِي بَكُورِيَّةٌ؟»
verses.en: And Esau said: 'Behold, I am at the point to die; and what profit shall the birthright do to me?'
verses.kjv: And Esau said, Behold, I [am] at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.web: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיֹּ֔ום וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֹ֑ו וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־בְּכֹרָתֹ֖ו לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ يَعْقُوبُ: «ٱحْلِفْ لِيَ ٱلْيَوْمَ». فَحَلَفَ لَهُ، فَبَاعَ بَكُورِيَّتَهُ لِيَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: And Jacob said: 'Swear to me first'; and he swore unto him; and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

verses.he: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ ס
verses.ar: فَأَعْطَى يَعْقُوبُ عِيسُوَ خُبْزًا وَطَبِيخَ عَدَسٍ، فَأَكَلَ وَشَرِبَ وَقَامَ وَمَضَى. فَٱحْتَقَرَ عِيسُو ٱلْبَكُورِيَّةَ.
verses.en: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised [his] birthright.
verses.web: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
